gui.craftlevel.skills.title: Skills
gui.craftlevel.skill.sense_of_prey.desc: Creates an aura that highlights all enemies within %s blocks for %ss.
gui.craftlevel.skill.ghost_saturation.de: For %ss, locks hunger and saturation at maximum, favoring natural regeneration.
gui.craftlevel.skill.soul_anchor.desc: On death, grants a %s%% chance to not lose a Soul.
gui.craftlevel.skill.spectral_climb.desc: While facing a wall and jumping, generates an impulse of up to %s blocks that scales the wall.
gui.craftlevel.skill.imbue_master.desc: Increases Imbue Potion yield, applying %s%% more imbue per potion.
gui.craftlevel.skill.vampire_attack.desc: For %2$ss, all melee attacks against enemies heal you for %1$s%% of the damage dealt.
gui.craftlevel.skill.spirit_return.desc: Creates a spectral mist that marks your position for %s min. Crouch to return to the marked position.
gui.craftlevel.skill.carnage.desc: Over %s min, killing hostile enemies grants a %s%% damage bonus. Stacks up to %s times, and each stack lasts 1 min.
gui.craftlevel.skill.supernova.desc: Creates a gravity field that pulls enemies within %s blocks for %ss. When it ends, it unleashes a massive explosion.
gui.craftlevel.skill.protective_shockwav: Creates a large explosion that deals no damage but knocks hostile enemies away within %s blocks, granting invulnerability for %ss.
gui.craftlevel.skill.soul_render.desc: Your next melee attack marks an enemy until it dies, making all attacks deal %s%% more damage to that target.
gui.craftlevel.skill.light_speed.desc: Grants +%s%% movement speed and invisibility, reducing your damage dealt to 0 for %ss.
gui.craftlevel.skill.darkness_light.desc: Turns you into a bright light source for %ss, illuminating the darkness.
gui.craftlevel.skill.miner_frenzy.desc: Grants a %s%% mining speed bonus for %ss.
gui.craftlevel.skill.last_chance.desc: When taking a lethal hit from an enemy, grants a last chance, leaving you at 1 HP instead of dying. %s min cooldown.
gui.craftlevel.skill.reinforced_bones.de: Grants a fall resistance bonus that reduces fall damage by %s%%.
gui.craftlevel.skill.mind_fury.desc: Drives up to %3$s hostile enemies within %1$s blocks mad for %2$ss, making them attack nearby hostiles.
gui.craftlevel.skill.nether_elevation.de: For %3$ss, applies Levitation %1$s and Wither %2$s to your Mob Focus target.
gui.craftlevel.skill.nether_rush.desc: Dashes %s blocks in your look direction, causing %s explosions along the path that set enemies on fire.
gui.craftlevel.skill.prospector.desc: Creates a colorful silhouette that highlights all ores within %s blocks for %s min.
gui.craftlevel.skill.frozen_mind.desc: Freezes the focused enemy's mind for %ss, preventing it from attacking or fleeing.
gui.craftlevel.skill.frozen_rush.desc: Creates a great dash that moves %s blocks in the aimed direction, freezing nearby mobs' minds for %ss within a %s-block radius of the charge.
gui.craftlevel.skill.goodnight.desc: Lets you sleep whenever and wherever you want, clearing the day and stopping rain, without setting a Spawn point.
gui.craftlevel.skill.recall.desc: Creates a magic rune that, while crouching and right-clicking the top of a block, marks your coordinates. Hold right-click to teleport to the marked location. %s min cooldown after teleport.
gui.craftlevel.skill.sky_walker.desc: For 30s, creates a platform under your feet that lets you walk on air, water, and lava.
gui.craftlevel.skill.inferno_bolt.desc: Launches a fireball in your look direction, causing an explosion in a %s-block radius and igniting enemies. Fires %s bolt(s).
gui.craftlevel.skill.soul_lance.desc: Launches a spectral trident that deals %s%% damage and unleashes %s massive lightning bolt(s) on the hit enemy.
gui.craftlevel.skill.blink_step.desc: Teleports you %s blocks in the aimed direction, always landing on top of the terrain.
gui.craftlevel.skill.crippling_aura.desc: Creates a large ground mist in a %s-block radius, applying Slow %s and Weakness %s to all enemies for %ss.
gui.craftlevel.skill.terror_pulse.desc: Instills fear in all enemies within %1$s blocks for %2$ss, making them flee from you.
gui.craftlevel.skill.vampire_blood.desc: At night, grants the Vampire bonus that increases max health by %s%% and melee damage by %s%%.
gui.craftlevel.skill.quick_survive.desc: When health drops below %s%%, grants a %s%% movement speed bonus.
gui.craftlevel.skill.blood_rush.desc: When you eliminate a focused enemy, grants %s%% movement speed and damage for %ss. Cooldown: %ss.
gui.craftlevel.skill.strength_recovery.d: When health drops below %s%%, grants an absorption bonus equal to %s%% of max health. %s min cooldown.
